Transfer allowance atomically to per-report jobs keyed by finding/evidence revision; never reopen or overload a completed execution lease. Unused allowance has an explicit bounded review window/release policy; late confirmation after release requires new explicit report authorization. Missing configuration leaves report-needed status, never unbudgeted inference. F02 owns the enabling controls in composer/review.

Evaluation completion can release its target reservation while authorized report accounting remains intact; aggregate jobs cannot exceed the held allowance.
Cancellation/expiry releases only provably unused funds; ambiguous model delivery stays held.
